name: The Fulham Shore PLC
summary: The Fulham Shore PLC owns, operates, and manages restaurants in the United Kingdom. As of February 8, 2021, it operated 19 restaurants under the The Real Greek name across London and Southern England; and 53 restaurants under the Franco Manca pizzeria brand, primarily in London, also with restaurants in Edinburgh, Manchester, Leeds, Cambridge, Bath, Oxford, Bristol and Exeter. The company also franchises Franco Manca pizzeria on the island of Salina in Italy. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in London, the United Kingdom.
